name: What factors determine the cost of interior log sealing?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of interior log sealing?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of interior log sealing depends on overall square footage, wall height, the depth of log gaps, and whether old, failing sealants require mechanical removal before new work begins. High cathedral ceilings or lofts require interior staging or specialized scaffolding, which adds labor time compared to single-story rooms. Additionally, if the project involves integrating sealed logs with finished carpentry, drywall transitions, or interior staining, the combined scope of finish work will influence the estimate. An on-site assessment determines how much joint preparation and wood conditioning are necessary before sealing starts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost depends on wall square footage, ceiling heights, the condition of old caulking, joint width, and the amount of surface cleaning or finish carpentry needed.
